TempestResearchManifest (S7)

Source: R/research-manifest.R
TempestResearchManifest.Rd

A small immutable value contract describing the identities and references used by one STORM or Co-STORM research run. Runtime clients, credentials, stores, tools, and executable objects are deliberately excluded.

Usage

TempestResearchManifest(
  schema_version = 3L,
  research_run_id = character(0),
  mode = character(0),
  config_digest = character(0),
  programs = list(),
  knowledge_snapshot = list(),
  runtime = list(),
  traces = list(),
  deliverables = list(),
  status = character(0)
)
